evidence.title: Sardinian village where more women reach 100 may be new centenarian ‘blue zone’

occurrences.checkable_against: Frontiers in Aging study on Bolotana female longevity
occurrences.quote_span: A study by professors at Sardinia’s University of Sassari and the University of Alabama at Birmingham in the US, published in the scientific journal Frontiers in Aging, found that 13.8% of women in the village who reach the age of 70 will live to 100 – placing it second in the world for female longevity after Hong Kong.
occurrences.speaker: study by professors at Sardinia’s University of Sassari and the University of Alabama at Birmingham
occurrences.subject: Bolotana centenarian longevity

occurrences.checkable_against: Comparative findings in the Bolotana longevity study
occurrences.quote_span: The findings also showed that, compared with the world’s other four blue zones – Okinawa in Japan, the Nicoya peninsula in Costa Rica, Ikaria in Greece and Loma Linda in California in the US – Sardinia’s zone was expanding.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Bolotana centenarian longevity

occurrences.checkable_against: 1999 classification of Sardinian villages among the world's blue zones
occurrences.quote_span: Sardinia became known as a haven for longevity, especially for long-lived men, in 1999 when a cluster of remote villages nestled in the slopes of its central and eastern provinces were classified among the world’s five “blue zones” – geographic areas with high concentrations of centenarians.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Bolotana centenarian longevity

occurrences.checkable_against: Comparative sex-specific longevity data for Bolotana and Sardinia's original blue zone
occurrences.quote_span: “But while Bolotana shares the same characteristics, it is even more exceptional. Whereas the original zone had an unusual balance between the two sexes, here female longevity prevails.”
occurrences.speaker: Giovanni Mario Pes
occurrences.subject: Bolotana centenarian longevity

occurrences.checkable_against: Bolotana longevity study and Sardinia blue-zone research record
occurrences.quote_span: “The important thing is that, for the first time in more than 25 years, we have found a place for longevity outside of the conventional blue zone [in Sardinia],” Giovanni Mario Pes, the study’s lead scientist and a co-creator of the blue zone concept, told the Guardian.
occurrences.speaker: Giovanni Mario Pes
occurrences.subject: Bolotana centenarian longevity

occurrences.checkable_against: researchers' study and demographic records for Bolotana
occurrences.quote_span: Now Bolotana, located in the Margine area of central Sardinia about 70 miles (110km) from the island’s original blue zone, has emerged as a new potential candidate, researchers say, generating centenarians every year in a trend driven by women.
occurrences.speaker: researchers
occurrences.subject: Bolotana centenarian longevity

occurrences.checkable_against: Bolotana municipal death records and current centenarian roster
occurrences.quote_span: Six have since died and the six who are left are all women, the two eldest being 102.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Bolotana centenarian longevity

occurrences.checkable_against: Bolotana municipal population and centenarian records
occurrences.quote_span: The study began in 2024 and as of last year there were 12 centenarians among a population of 2,266 in Bolotana – roughly 12 times the Sardinian average.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Bolotana centenarian longevity

occurrences.checkable_against: Giovanna Marras's residence and medical or cognitive assessment records
occurrences.quote_span: He gave the example of Giovanna Marras, 101, who lives with her sister. “They live together, they cook together, they talk to each other easily,” said Pes. “There was absolutely no sign of cognitive decline.”
occurrences.speaker: Giovanni Mario Pes
occurrences.subject: Bolotana centenarian longevity

occurrences.checkable_against: Bolotana birth and longevity records for people born 1900-1925
occurrences.quote_span: The researchers analysed records of people born in Bolotana between 1900 and 1925 and found that 38 had lived beyond 100, putting their longevity rate at 57% higher than the Italian national average.
occurrences.speaker: researchers
occurrences.subject: Bolotana centenarian longevity

occurrences.checkable_against: Interviews and observational records concerning Bolotana centenarian social relationships
occurrences.quote_span: However, after spending time with sprightly centenarian women there, he said what struck him most were the “very intense and very real social relations” maintained throughout their lives.
occurrences.speaker: Giovanni Mario Pes
occurrences.subject: Bolotana centenarian longevity

occurrences.checkable_against: Bolotana population and birth records tracking residents reaching age 100
occurrences.quote_span: More residents are expected to reach the milestone age by the end of this year and during 2027.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Bolotana centenarian longevity

occurrences.checkable_against: Comparative female longevity statistics for Bolotana and Western populations
occurrences.quote_span: Pes said that while it was already well established that women lived longer for biological reasons, “the extraordinary thing is that the longevity of the women in Bolotana is three times higher than that of most western women”.
